ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited delivered exceptionally strong Q1FY27 financial results, reporting 27% year-over-year revenue growth and a significant 141.94% surge in Profit After Tax, driven by improved operating efficiencies and expanding margins. The new EVOQ360 pit-less smart home lift product is a key takeaway, already contributing 5-7% to revenue with healthy margins and competitive features, indicating a promising growth avenue. The company forecasts 25-30% revenue growth for FY27, aiming to increase capacity utilization and expand market reach across its core businesses, with no material red flags noted.
